mapper.sql: id, tenant_id, customer_id, resource_id, resource_type, appointment_date, appointment_time, duration, total_amount, status, notes, rating, review, created_at, updated_at
mapper.select: SELECT a.id, a.tenant_id, a.customer_id, a.resource_id, a.resource_type, a.appointment_date, a.appointment_time, a.duration, a.total_amount, a.status, a.notes, a.rating, a.review, a.created_at, a.updated_at, c.first_name as customer_first_name, c.last_name as customer_last_name, c.phone as customer_phone, c.email as customer_email, r.name as resource_name, r.type as resource_type, aps.id as appointment_service_id, aps.service_id as appointment_service_service_id, aps.service_name as appointment_service_name, aps.price as appointment_service_price, aps.duration as appointment_service_duration FROM appointments a LEFT JOIN customers c ON a.customer_id = c.id LEFT JOIN resource r ON a.resource_id = r.id LEFT JOIN appointment_services aps ON a.id = aps.appointment_id WHERE a.id = #{id}

SELECT a.id, a.tenant_id, a.customer_id, a.resource_id, a.resource_type, a.appointment_date, a.appointment_time, a.duration, a.total_amount, a.status, a.notes, a.rating, a.review, a.created_at, a.updated_at, c.first_name as customer_first_name, c.last_name as customer_last_name, c.phone as customer_phone, c.email as customer_email, r.name as resource_name, r.type as resource_type, aps.id as appointment_service_id, aps.service_id as appointment_service_service_id, aps.service_name as appointment_service_name, aps.price as appointment_service_price, aps.duration as appointment_service_duration FROM appointments a LEFT JOIN customers c ON a.customer_id = c.id LEFT JOIN resource r ON a.resource_id = r.id LEFT JOIN appointment_services aps ON a.id = aps.appointment_id WHERE a.tenant_id = #{tenantId} ORDER BY a.created_at DESC, a.appointment_date DESC, a.appointment_time DESC
SELECT FROM appointments WHERE customer_id = #{customerId} AND tenant_id = #{tenantId} ORDER BY appointment_date DESC, appointment_time DESC
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM appointments WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND status = 'CONFIRMED'
SELECT AVG(rating) FROM appointments WHERE customer_id = #{customerId} AND rating IS NOT NULL
mapper.update: UPDATE appointments SET tenant_id = #{tenantId}, customer_id = #{customerId}, resource_id = #{resourceId}, resource_type = #{resourceType}, appointment_date = #{appointmentDate}, appointment_time = #{appointmentTime}, duration = #{duration}, total_amount = #{totalAmount}, status = #{status}, notes = #{notes}, rating = #{rating}, review = #{review}, updated_at = #{updatedAt} WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT id, appointment_id as appointmentId, service_id as serviceId, service_name as serviceName, price, duration, created_at as createdAt FROM appointment_services WHERE appointment_id = #{appointmentId}

mapper.select: SELECT FROM appointments WHERE status = 'CONFIRMED' ORDER BY appointment_date, appointment_time

SELECT a.id, a.tenant_id, a.customer_id, a.resource_id, a.resource_type, a.appointment_date, a.appointment_time, a.duration, a.total_amount, a.status, a.notes, a.rating, a.review, a.created_at, a.updated_at, c.first_name as customer_first_name, c.last_name as customer_last_name, c.phone as customer_phone, c.email as customer_email, r.name as resource_name, r.type as resource_type FROM appointments a LEFT JOIN customers c ON a.customer_id = c.id LEFT JOIN resource r ON a.resource_id = r.id WHERE a.appointment_date BETWEEN #{startDate} AND #{endDate} AND a.status = 'CONFIRMED' ORDER BY a.appointment_date, a.appointment_time

SELECT a.id, a.tenant_id, a.customer_id, a.resource_id, a.resource_type, a.appointment_date, a.appointment_time, a.duration, a.total_amount, a.status, a.notes, a.rating, a.review, a.created_at, a.updated_at, c.first_name as customer_first_name, c.last_name as customer_last_name, c.phone as customer_phone, c.email as customer_email, r.name as resource_name, r.type as resource_type FROM appointments a LEFT JOIN customers c ON a.customer_id = c.id LEFT JOIN resource r ON a.resource_id = r.id WHERE a.appointment_date = #{date} AND a.appointment_time BETWEEN #{startTime} AND #{endTime} AND a.status = 'CONFIRMED' ORDER BY a.appointment_time
